segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ בֶּן תֵּשַׁע שָׁנִים וְיוֹם אֶחָד שֶׁבָּא עַל יְבִמְתּוֹ וּמֵת — חוֹלֶצֶת וְלֹא מִתְיַיבֶּמֶת. נָשָׂא אִשָּׁה וָמֵת — הֲרֵי זוֹ פְּטוּרָה. בֶּן תֵּשַׁע שָׁנִים וְיוֹם אֶחָד שֶׁבָּא עַל יְבִמְתּוֹ, וּמִשֶּׁהִגְדִּיל נָשָׂא אִשָּׁה אַחֶרֶת, וָמֵת, אִם לֹא יָדַע אֶת הָרִאשׁוֹנָה מִשֶּׁהִגְדִּיל — הָרִאשׁוֹנָה חוֹלֶצֶת וְלֹא מִתְיַיבֶּמֶת, וְהַשְּׁנִיָּיה אוֹ חוֹלֶצֶת אוֹ מִתְיַיבֶּמֶת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If a boy «aged nine years and one day had relations with his yevama and died,» that yevama «performs ḥalitza and may not enter into levirate marriage.» If the minor «married a woman» in a regular manner «and died, she is exempt» from levirate marriage and ḥalitza, as by Torah law a minor cannot marry. If a boy «aged nine years and one day had relations with his yevama, and after he matured he married a different woman and» then «died» childless, «if he did not» carnally «know the first» woman «after he matured,» but only when he was a minor, «the first one performs ḥalitza and may not enter into levirate marriage,» as she is in essence a yevama who had relations with a minor, «and the second» woman «either performs ḥalitza or enters into levirate marriage,» as she is his full-fledged wife.

segments.he: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: מְיַיבֵּם לְאֵי זוֹ שֶׁיִּרְצֶה, וְחוֹלֵץ לַשְּׁנִיָּיה. אֶחָד שֶׁהוּא בֶּן תֵּשַׁע שָׁנִים וְיוֹם אֶחָד, וְאֶחָד שֶׁהוּא בֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שֶׁלֹּא הֵבִיא שְׁתֵּי שְׂעָרוֹת.
segments.en: «Rabbi Shimon says:» The brother «consummates levirate marriage with whichever» woman «he chooses, and performs ḥalitza with the second one.» The mishna comments: This is the halakha «both» for a boy «who is nine years and one day old, and also» for one «who is twenty» years «old who has not developed two» pubic «hairs.» He has the status of a nine-year-old boy in this regard, as his intercourse is not considered a proper act of intercourse.

moves.cueHe: בן תשע שנים ויום אחד שבא על יבמתו ומת
moves.summary: ḥalitza not yibum; a minor's wife exempt; the first performs ḥalitza, the second either

moves.cueHe: רבי שמעון אומר: מייבם לאי זו שירצה
moves.summary: R' Shimon: yibum with whichever he chooses
moves.about: whether the woman a minor had relations with must perform ḥalitza only, or the yavam may take either wife in levirate marriage

moves.cueHe: אחד שהוא בן תשע שנים ויום אחד, ואחד שהוא בן עשרים
moves.summary: same law for a twenty-year-old without two hairs
